notes: Owner-decided acceptance gates (spec §33.5). Versioned so the thresholds live in one place instead of scattered literals across graders. Precision-first: we would rather ship narrow and correct than broad and wrong. These are the bar for calling a capability design-partner ready; the eval report evaluates each run against them and emits PASS/FAIL per capability. A capability that does not clear every criterion is NOT ready, regardless of how green the rest of the suite looks.

fettler-impact-analysis.description: Fettler impact analysis: given a structured API change, flag exactly the impacted source files (precision/recall on flag_files scenarios; abstain/no_op scenarios are graded elsewhere).
